channel.title: Onramp Radar
channel.description: Everything Claude shipped, in plain words, newest first.

item.title: Monthly API credits
item.description: Max and Team plans now include monthly credits for building your own apps and agents on the API.

item.title: Claude Code cloud sessions
item.description: Run Claude Code on a machine of its own, so a task keeps going when your laptop sleeps.

item.title: Claude Code mods
item.description: Small plugins that change how Claude Code looks and behaves, from a context readout to guards on commands.

item.title: Plugin submissions
item.description: Developers can submit plugins to the Claude directory and follow them through review.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5
item.description: The first Claude 5.5 model, which Anthropic says matches Fable 5.1 on most work for less.

item.title: Cowork in every conversation
item.description: Ask a quick question or hand over a bigger job in the same chat, with no mode to pick first.

item.title: Designs, decks and docs anywhere
item.description: Ask for a design, a deck or a living document in any conversation and edit it beside the chat.

item.title: Salesforce in Claude
item.description: A plugin that brings your Salesforce accounts and pipeline into Claude, with sales skills built in.

item.title: Smart reports
item.description: Enterprise admins get a report on how their team uses Claude, what it costs and where it gets stuck.

item.title: Dispatch
item.description: Send Claude a job from your phone and pick up the result later.

item.title: Design to slides
item.description: Turn a design file into a deck without rebuilding the layouts.

item.title: Skill packs
item.description: Drop in a folder of instructions and Claude follows your house rules.

item.title: Chrome reads PDFs
item.description: The sidebar can read the PDF you have open and answer from it.

item.title: Component export
item.description: Send a design component straight to code as real, named files.
